hooks.command: PROMPT=$(jq -r '.prompt'); REPO_ROOT="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || echo '.')"; "$REPO_ROOT/.venv/bin/agent-kg" ingest "$PROMPT" --role user --repo "$REPO_ROOT" 2>/dev/null || true

MSG=$(jq -r '.last_assistant_message // empty'); REPO_ROOT="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || echo '.')"; [ -n "$MSG" ] && "$REPO_ROOT/.venv/bin/agent-kg" ingest "$MSG" --role assistant --repo "$REPO_ROOT" --no-embed 2>/dev/null || true
